title: A pass that has barely changed
text: Apart from the paved road, Walker Pass is essentially unaltered since Joseph R. Walker mapped it in 1834. John Frémont's survey expedition used the pass in 1845, and Frémont suggested it be named for Walker. The Pacific Crest Trail crosses there.

s1.title: Walker Pass
